news.title: Career-best Wembanyama display seals Spurs win
news.summary: Victor Wembanyama sinks the winning free throw to finish with a career-high 52 points as the San Antonio Spurs beat the Dallas Mavericks 112-111.

news.title: Valkyries win WNBA title in their second season
news.summary: The Golden State Valkyries win the Women's NBA title by beating Atlanta Dream in the finals decider.

news.title: Boos to cheers - James records biggest career comeback win
news.summary: LeBron James says his home debut was "everything that I dreamed of and more" after the Philadelphia 76ers turned boos into cheers by overhauling a 29-point deficit to beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 114-106.

news.title: Trump says NBA star LeBron James 'disrespected' US anthem
news.summary: The basketball star recently appeared to be practising a golf swing and basketball shots while the national anthem was performed.

news.title: LeBron James' 76ers beat Knicks on NBA opening night
news.summary: LeBron James scores 14 points on debut for the Philadelphia 76ers as they defeat champions the New York Knicks on the opening night of the NBA season.

news.title: The season has just started - so how does the NBA work?
news.summary: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains the format of the NBA ahead of the start of the 2026-27 season starting on Tuesday

news.title: Reese stars as Dream win first WNBA Finals match
news.summary: Atlanta Dream win their first ever game in the WNBA Finals as they beat the Golden State Valkyries 79-65 to level the series at 1-1.

news.title: The Welshman seeking NBA title with Timberwolves
news.summary: British-born assistant coach Tim Lewis is aiming to win the NBA title with the Minnesota Timberwolves after joining Chris Finch's staff.

news.title: Guardiola receives standing ovation at Barcelona EuroLeague match
news.summary: Former Manchester City and Barcelona manager Pep Guardiola received a standing ovation from the crowd while attending Barcelona's EuroLeague basketball match against Olympiacos.

news.title: Jordan 'Last Dance' jersey sells for record £10.6m
news.summary: A Michael Jordan jersey from his 'Last Dance' season sells for $14m (£10.6m), a record for a piece of basketball memorabilia.

news.title: Wilson becomes first five-time MVP in WNBA history
news.summary: A ceremony marking her record-extending fifth MVP award will take place on Friday night, but A'ja Wilson will not take part before a must-win game.

news.title: NBA's first MVP Pettit dies aged 93
news.summary: Bob Pettit, one of the earliest stars of the NBA and the first man to win the MVP award, has died aged 93.

news.title: The transgender controversy surrounding the WNBA
news.summary: After the Indiana Fever's Sophie Cunningham said it was "common sense" to ban transgender women from women's sports, a row has emerged in the WNBA - with former NBA players saying eligibility rules mean they can enter the 2027 Draft.

news.title: The Briton who remains in demand in NBA at 74
news.summary: BBC Sport charts the remarkable career of Alex McKechnie, who left Scotland to become one of the NBA's top physiotherapists with a reputation of saving basketball careers.

news.title: Chess, monks & Nasa - Wembanyama's unusual pre-season
news.summary: Victor Wembanyama gets his third campaign with the San Antonio Spurs under way on Wednesday, eight months after a deep vein thrombosis diagnosis.

news.title: From escaping civil war in South Sudan to 10th pick at NBA Draft
news.summary: Khaman Maluach only took up basketball aged 13, but the refugee from South Sudan has been drafted to join NBA side Phoenix Suns.
